posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
Hmmm, does Caethyril's plugin allow you to do that?
MZ - Modify Cae's Picture Z Container Plugin to allow only a specific range of Pictures to be changed?
So, it's pretty well-known that pictures have a Z axis, and depending on the value of the z AND something called 'Containers', pictures could either show above something like weather effects or below Event sprites.  Changing that priority value isn't available by default. However, @caethyril has...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
